name: The Inn
source:
You are a detective who was just passing by the inn and decided to rest there. Imagine how unlucky you are.

[From [url=https://fastlite.itch.io/the-inn-old]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名侦探，只是路过这家旅馆，决定在这里歇歇脚。想想看，你得有多倒霉。

[摘自[url=https://fastlite.itch.io/the-inn-old]Itch.io[/url]]
